notes: City of Calera zoning parcels layer (Zoning_view, FeatureServer layer 4), hosted on city ArcGIS org. zone_name is coded domain ZONING_DESC; ZoningBook holds an HTML link to the ordinance page labelled with the district code (e.g. R-1 Zoning).
